```yaml
name: Lazer Sui Contract CI

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "lazer/contracts/sui/**"
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - "lazer/contracts/sui/**"

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Sui CLI
        run: |
          curl -L https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MystenLabs/sui/main/crates/sui-cli/bin/install.sh | bash
          echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Run Sui Move Tests
        run: |
          cd lazer/contracts/sui/
          sui move test
```
